composition_summary: Preserved the supplied volatile message unchanged; no justified prompt repair was warranted. The task is a single class-22 PythonCode draft. The requested semantics are a raw validator: it must accept only the exact booleans True and False, treat missing/null/any-other-value as invalid, and return {valid:boolean, flag:original bool if valid else null} without raising or coercing. The body uses a small helper check_flag that returns the exact decision, and the module scope invokes it with inputs.get('flag') so result is assigned on every outcome. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or type coercion are used. The draft is an unapproved proposal; no submission, activation, tests or approval claims are made. Supported sink fields (name/description/content) are used; class 21/1-3/13 are not supported in this sink.

payload.name: pc-check-flag
payload.description: Raw validator returning whether a raw candidate flag is exactly the boolean True or False. Accepts missing, null or any non-boolean value as invalid. Returns {valid, flag} where flag is the original boolean when valid and null otherwise. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or type coercion.
